decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - 5	No internal works shall be carried out before a photographic survey of the affected parts of the interior of the property identifying all features of architectural and historic interest and how they will be protected for the duration of the works to the building, retained and, if appropriate, reused has been carried out and submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Any proposals so approved shall be carried out as part of the development.

Condition : 3 - 6	No work shall be carried out until a method statement for the proposed works has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The statement shall include a roof plan for the proposed extension, details of how the structure will be supported and how the retained structural features are to be protected during building works.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, and formation of a front lightwell incorporating internal alterations to basement level of house
